extensions.name: Card Timer
extensions.summary: Show a countdown target beside each review card to help pace study sessions.
extensions.description: Choose a target from 5 seconds to 5 minutes and see the remaining time while you study. When time runs out, the card stays open so you can reveal the answer and grade it when you are ready. Card Timer does not read notes or connect to the internet.

extensions.name: Image Occlusion
extensions.summary: Turn an image into recall cards by hiding the regions you want to remember.
extensions.description: Upload a diagram, map, anatomy image, or other labeled picture and draw masks over the details you want to recall. Image Occlusion creates one card per hidden region and includes keyboard controls plus image descriptions for accessible authoring. Images stay local and are never sent over the internet.

extensions.name: Collection Insights
extensions.summary: See due cards, deck sizes, common tags, and notes that need attention.
extensions.description: Get a quick overview of total notes and cards, today's workload, deck sizes, frequently used tags, empty prompts, empty answers, and untagged notes. Collection Insights reports facts about the current collection; it does not estimate mastery. It cannot edit your collection or connect to the internet.

extensions.name: Anki & CSV Import/Export
extensions.summary: Preview, import, and export Anki packages and CSV files.
extensions.description: Move study material between Neo Anki, Anki, and spreadsheets. Preview notes, cards, media, warnings, and compatibility details before importing an .apkg, .colpkg, or CSV file. Export the current collection in the same formats. Every import creates a rollback checkpoint, and all files are processed locally.

extensions.name: More Card Types
extensions.summary: Create reverse, fill-in-the-blank, typed-answer, and audio-first cards.
extensions.description: Add four ways to study beyond a basic front and back: reverse cards, fill-in-the-blank cloze cards, typed answers with comparison feedback, and audio-first prompts. More Card Types sees only the note and card currently being created or studied and cannot connect to the internet.

extensions.name: Review Priorities
extensions.summary: Choose oldest-overdue or quick-wins ordering when a review queue grows.
extensions.description: Select Oldest overdue first to tackle cards that have waited longest, or Quick wins first to begin with shorter, easier reviews. These choices change only the order of cards already eligible for study; they do not change due dates, grades, or review history.

extensions.name: Learning Packs
extensions.summary: Install and update reusable learning packs without losing local changes.
extensions.description: Install versioned sets of notes and cards from Neo Anki pack files. When a publisher releases an update, Learning Packs applies new material while retaining your local edits and review progress. If both sides changed the same field, your value is kept and the conflict is shown for review. Pack files are processed locally.

extensions.name: Text to Speech
extensions.summary: Add spoken prompts and answers with device voices or cloud providers.
extensions.description: Play audio live while studying or generate it ahead of time for consistent offline playback. Create profiles by collection or tag and choose system voices, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, or Azure Speech. Cloud text goes directly to the provider you select; API keys stay encrypted on this device. Provider charges may apply.

extensions.name: Goals & Saved Searches
extensions.summary: Set learning goals and save Library searches for quick reuse.
extensions.description: Create learning goals with optional deadlines and search terms. Matching cards receive a modest priority boost in daily plans, while saved Library searches make recurring filters easy to reopen. Goals and searches synchronize across your Neo Anki devices; the extension cannot edit notes or connect to the internet.
